name: Lumen landing page
request: Make a simple landing page for Lumen from the brief, and let me OK it before anything is saved to the site.

steps.prompt: Read brief.md. Write notes.md with three short sections: who Lumen is for, the three strongest benefits in plain words, and words to use and to avoid.

steps.asks: wants to save the landing page to site/index.html
steps.prompt: Using brief.md and notes.md, write site/index.html: one self-contained HTML page with inline CSS. Include a headline, the three benefits, the price, and a single "Get Lumen" button. Calm and plain, no hype. Keep it under 150 lines.
Read brief.md and write faq.md with four questions a first-time visitor would ask about Lumen, each answered in one or two sentences. Only use facts from the brief.

Read brief.md and site/index.html. Check that the price, the tone and the call to action match the brief. Write review.md as a short pass/fail checklist with one line of advice for anything that fails.
